newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV sees 1997 results on 1996 level.
newsitem.headline: OMV sees 1997 results on 1996 level.

text.p: Austrian oil and chemicals group OMV said on Tuesday it expected current year earnings to be on a similar level as last year's.
"I expect a similar result for 1997 as in 1996," chief executive Richard Schenz told a news conference.
"From today's point of view, we expect a good development of earnings," he added.
The group, Austria's biggest industrial concern, earlier reported a 14.5 percent rise in 1996 group net profit to a record 1.981 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
